detail.description:
Join millions of players worldwide as you build your village, raise a clan, and compete in epic Clan Wars!

Mustachioed Barbarians, fire wielding Wizards, and other unique troops are waiting for you! Enter the world of Clash!

Classic Features:
● Join a Clan of fellow players or start your own and invite friends.
● Fight in Clan Wars as a team against millions of active players across the globe.
● Test your skills in the competitive Clan War Leagues and prove you’re the best.
● Forge alliances,
detail.recentChanges:
A Helping Hand!
• Builder Base Gets a Second Builder: B.O.T.O is eager to help with Builder Base upgrades and unlocks after getting all Builder’s Huts in Home Village.
• A Hero Arrives Early: Barbarian King now unlocks at Town Hall 4 instead of Town Hall 7.
• Gold Pass Improvements: Consecutive buyers of Gold Pass get additional task cards as a loyalty reward, and players who get Gold Pass after finishing the track no longer miss out on bonus points.
